args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1 to production, checkout-api failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. We rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before deploying it again.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** All three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) were on v2.3.1. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Version chosen:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I skipped v2.3.1-rc because it only ran in staging, where it was also unhealthy.
- **After:** All three regions are on v2.3.0, health checks pass and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 says v2.3.1 failed and that we rolled back to v2.3.0. It asks for the cause of the v2.3.1 failure to be found before anyone deploys it again.

No approval was needed, because v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
